final_answer:
CC-26-022 lists only SOP-MFG-104 as impacted. Raising the target MOI from 5.0 to 8.0 TU/cell also breaks the EBR range limit, the PPQ acceptance range and the transduction risk assessment. The trace links show the CC has a single IMPACTS link, to SOP-MFG-104.

**Items to action**

| Item | Action | In the CC? |
|---|---|---|
| SOP-MFG-104 (v2.0, Lentiviral transduction: MOI calculation and addition) | Revise to the new 8.0 target MOI. | Yes, the only item named. |
| URS-EBR-009 (EBR requirement: "Target MOI outside 4.0–6.0 TU/cell shall be rejected for GMP runs") | Revise the requirement. At 8.0 it would reject every run. | No |
| CS-EBR-03 (EBR range check configured as MOI 4.0–6.0, hard stop) | Reconfigure the range check, then re-test it under change control. | No |
| New or supplementary OQ test case for the range check (to be added under OQ-EBR-01) | Add a test that verifies URS-EBR-009 and CS-EBR-03 at the new limits. No existing test case verifies either item. | No |
| FRA-042 (RA-FRA-EBR, "Function fails: MOI outside 4.0–6.0 rejected", severity 9, HIGH) | Re-assess against the new limit and confirm the "SCRIPTED (robust)" assurance approach still holds. | No |
| FM-05 (MOI above target, VCN, RPN 108, HIGH) and FM-06 (MOI below target, %CAR+ and potency, RPN 128, HIGH), both in RA-PFMEA-001 | Re-assess severity, occurrence and detection at the higher MOI. Update RA-PFMEA-001 and its controls. | No |
| PPQ-001, CPP criterion 1 (MOI 4.0–6.0 TU/cell) | 8.0 is outside the qualified range. All five PPQ batches (PPQ26-01 to -05) ran at MOI 5.0. The PPQ needs a supplement or re-qualification at the new MOI, or the CPP range must be justified and re-approved. The protocol is still "EXECUTION COMPLETE - REPORT PENDING". | No |
| PPQ-001, CQA criteria 8 (%CAR+ ≥20) and 9 (VCN ≤5.0 copies/CAR+ cell) | Re-confirm both at the new MOI as part of the PPQ work. | No |

**What the CC misses:** everything except SOP-MFG-104. That is URS-EBR-009, CS-EBR-03, the new range-check test, FRA-042, FM-05, FM-06 and PPQ-001 (criteria 1, 8 and 9).

**Not needed**
- **Vector volume calculation (URS-EBR-007, CS-EBR-02, FRA-040):** the formula is the same at any MOI. TC-OQ-EBR-04 (TX-0083, PASS) already tested 2.5–10 TU/cell, which includes 8.0.
- **Analytical methods (AMV protocols):** the DoE data at MOI 10 stays inside the validated ranges. The highest per-CAR+ VCN was 3.34 copies/CAR+ cell, against a limit of 5.0. Potency was about 17,000 pg/mL, against a validated range of 500–25,000. The VCN method range is 0.1–6.0 copies/cell, and VCN by ddPCR at MOI 10 was about 2.3.

**Caveat:** the DoE runs (DOE-MOI-02 and -03) used MOI 2.5, 5, 10 and 15, not 8.0. At MOI 10, %CAR+ was 65–68%, against the minimum of 20%. This suggests 8.0 will meet the CQAs, but 8.0 has not been run directly, so the PPQ is still needed.

content.text:
CC-26-022 lists only SOP-MFG-104 as impacted. Raising the target MOI from 5.0 to 8.0 TU/cell also breaks the EBR range limit, the PPQ acceptance range and the transduction risk assessment. The trace links show the CC has a single IMPACTS link, to SOP-MFG-104.

**Items to action**

| Item | Action | In the CC? |
|---|---|---|
| SOP-MFG-104 (v2.0, Lentiviral transduction: MOI calculation and addition) | Revise to the new 8.0 target MOI. | Yes, the only item named. |
| URS-EBR-009 (EBR requirement: "Target MOI outside 4.0–6.0 TU/cell shall be rejected for GMP runs") | Revise the requirement. At 8.0 it would reject every run. | No |
| CS-EBR-03 (EBR range check configured as MOI 4.0–6.0, hard stop) | Reconfigure the range check, then re-test it under change control. | No |
| New or supplementary OQ test case for the range check (to be added under OQ-EBR-01) | Add a test that verifies URS-EBR-009 and CS-EBR-03 at the new limits. No existing test case verifies either item. | No |
| FRA-042 (RA-FRA-EBR, "Function fails: MOI outside 4.0–6.0 rejected", severity 9, HIGH) | Re-assess against the new limit and confirm the "SCRIPTED (robust)" assurance approach still holds. | No |
| FM-05 (MOI above target, VCN, RPN 108, HIGH) and FM-06 (MOI below target, %CAR+ and potency, RPN 128, HIGH), both in RA-PFMEA-001 | Re-assess severity, occurrence and detection at the higher MOI. Update RA-PFMEA-001 and its controls. | No |
| PPQ-001, CPP criterion 1 (MOI 4.0–6.0 TU/cell) | 8.0 is outside the qualified range. All five PPQ batches (PPQ26-01 to -05) ran at MOI 5.0. The PPQ needs a supplement or re-qualification at the new MOI, or the CPP range must be justified and re-approved. The protocol is still "EXECUTION COMPLETE - REPORT PENDING". | No |
| PPQ-001, CQA criteria 8 (%CAR+ ≥20) and 9 (VCN ≤5.0 copies/CAR+ cell) | Re-confirm both at the new MOI as part of the PPQ work. | No |

**What the CC misses:** everything except SOP-MFG-104. That is URS-EBR-009, CS-EBR-03, the new range-check test, FRA-042, FM-05, FM-06 and PPQ-001 (criteria 1, 8 and 9).

**Not needed**
- **Vector volume calculation (URS-EBR-007, CS-EBR-02, FRA-040):** the formula is the same at any MOI. TC-OQ-EBR-04 (TX-0083, PASS) already tested 2.5–10 TU/cell, which includes 8.0.
- **Analytical methods (AMV protocols):** the DoE data at MOI 10 stays inside the validated ranges. The highest per-CAR+ VCN was 3.34 copies/CAR+ cell, against a limit of 5.0. Potency was about 17,000 pg/mL, against a validated range of 500–25,000. The VCN method range is 0.1–6.0 copies/cell, and VCN by ddPCR at MOI 10 was about 2.3.

**Caveat:** the DoE runs (DOE-MOI-02 and -03) used MOI 2.5, 5, 10 and 15, not 8.0. At MOI 10, %CAR+ was 65–68%, against the minimum of 20%. This suggests 8.0 will meet the CQAs, but 8.0 has not been run directly, so the PPQ is still needed.
